contexts.text: The plucking away of the presence of truth Divine from those who are to be damned. Signified. For when they begin to hold truth Divine in aversion, they pluck themselves away from it.
When truth plucks itself away from good...
Pluck off the earrings of gold... () = the extraction of such things...
They as it were pluck themselves away from the Lord.
If they were plucked away from them before the appointed time...
What he has impressed on himself by confirmation... cannot be plucked off.
They began to pluck out from its hinges the door of the temple.
In order that they might be plucked away from the Roman Catholics.
